description:
Response_Able Futures is an Erasmus Mundus MFA that applies design practice to health and care challenges, run by a European consortium with studio-based pedagogy. Its admissions page describes the process for the next intake, where scholarship information is published with each call.

Programme Highlights

  • MFA-level design programme focused on health and care contexts
  • Studio and fieldwork approach across consortium campuses
  • Scholarship details announced with each admissions call
  • Graduates work in healthcare innovation, service design and social sectors

Who Should Apply

Design graduates and practitioners from product, service, graphic and social design, as well as healthcare professionals with design interest; portfolios are central.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus funding for selected students per the consortium's admission round.

Deadline and How to Apply

Follow the admissions-process section on the official site and prepare a portfolio aligned with care-focused design practice. Key deadline information: Admissions process for the next intake announced on the official application page.
